title: Micro-mosaic API onramp tiles for credential & toolcall flows
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Goal: Create a compact set of micro-illustrations (a "micro-mosaic") and annotated screenshot tiles to power the API/SDK onboarding quickstart pages. These assets should cover three core flows: API key provisioning and rotation, streaming responses (client play + server events), and tool-calling examples (function signatures, sample tool UI overlays).

Deliverables:
- 12 mosaic tiles (150x150/retina-ready) showing step-by-step micro-frames for: key create, key rotate, tokenless dev loop, streaming connect/fragment, streaming resume, tool call invoke, tool response parsing, error states, retry guidance, copy-safe snippets, accessibility variant, RTL variant.
- 3 annotated full-width screenshots (desktop): "Create key", "Start streaming", "Call tool", with callouts mapped to SDK snippets.
- 6 animated micro-GIFs (300px wide) demonstrating streaming chunked output, toolcall handshake, key rotation flow.
- A companion Figma page with exported SVG/PNG slices + component tokens (colors, spacing, CTA states) and a copy deck for microcopy localization.

Constraints & notes:
- Maintain consistent metaphor across tiles: a compact "card + arrow" motif used across other onboarding assets but with a new accent color to differentiate the API quickstart module. Avoid duplicating existing illustrations; this set should be intentionally more schematic and denser than previous playful artwork.
- Ensure all exported assets include a plain-background PNG and accessible SVG variant (with titles/aria friendly attributes).
- Deliver assets in organized file tree and with naming convention for CI ingestion: api_quick_mosaic_v1_<tile-name>.(svg|png|gif).

Acceptance criteria:
- All tiles and screenshots exported and uploaded to the onboarding-figma folder with slice tokens.
- Micro-GIFs validated under 500KB each via ffmpeg optimization script (provided in attachments).
- Design sign-off received from PM and engineering review for copy-to-code mapping.
- Component token file included for docs toolchain (colors, font sizes, spacing).
